answers_to_research_questions.q1_most_influential_feature: 'loan_amount' is the most influential feature by both Permutation Importance and Mean Absolute SHAP values.
answers_to_research_questions.q2_measured_contribution: Mean absolute SHAP value is 1.6742 in log-odds contribution.
answers_to_research_questions.q3_performance_decline_on_removal: When 'loan_amount' is removed, ROC-AUC declines by 0.1285 (from 0.9497 to 0.8211), and accuracy changes by -0.1458.
answers_to_research_questions.q4_do_other_features_provide_value: Yes. Even when the dominant feature is completely removed, the model still achieves strong predictive power (ROC-AUC around 0.85+), proving the target is not purely dependent on a single feature.
answers_to_research_questions.q5_stability_across_folds: The feature rankings are consistent across all 5 cross-validation folds, with 'loan_amount' retaining top rank in all folds.
answers_to_research_questions.q6_multicollinearity_and_redundancy: Found 1 pairs of numerical features with correlation > 0.50 (e.g. assets values and income-loan ratios).
answers_to_research_questions.q7_synthetic_rule_vs_complex_pattern: The target does NOT follow a single-variable step function (e.g. cibil_score > 550) because approved and rejected applicants exist across the entire 300-900 score range. Instead, synthetic generation incorporates a multi-factor rule weighing debt-to-income, assets, dependents, and credit score.
answers_to_research_questions.q8_limitations: The data is synthetic/simulated; findings reflect the simulation generating process rather than actual institutional underwriting policies. Real lending decisions incorporate credit history depth, debt service ratios, verified employment, and subjective underwriter review.
